currentKeyFields.subtitleJa: ヘブロンの旧名の由来とされる人物
currentKeyFields.summaryJa: ヨシュア記14:15は、ヘブロンの旧名をキルヤテ・アルバとし、その名がアナク人の中で最も偉大な人物にちなむと述べます。
currentKeyFields.identityNoteJa: ヨシュア記14:15は、キルヤテ・アルバという旧名が「アナク人の中で最も偉大な人物」にちなむと述べます。この節はその人物の経歴を別に説明しません。

facts.textJa: ヨシュア記15:13は、キルヤテ・アルバを「アナクの父」にちなんだ名として説明します。

records.basisJa: 14:15 ties Kiriath Arba to the greatest man among Anakim, and 15:13/21:11 say named after Anak’s father; this supports an eponym but the text never separately states the personal name Arba. Current note avoids biography, but person-level identification remains inferential.

primaryWitnesses.text: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).
They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

currentKeyFields.subtitleJa: 北方の相続地に名が出る部族
currentKeyFields.summaryJa: ヨシュア記17:10では、マナセの相続地の北にアシェル、東にイッサカルが接すると記されます。ここは部族名を指します。
currentKeyFields.identityNoteJa: ヨシュア記17:7の「アシェル」は境界の起点として現れ、部族か地名かが固定WEBだけでは確定しない。17:10以後の明確な用例は部族。族祖個人とは区別。
currentKeyFields.historicalRoleJa: ヨシュア記で割当地と氏族領域に名が記される部族

facts.textJa: ヨシュア記19:24は、アシェルの部族に第五のくじが当たったと記します。

records.basisJa: 17:7 says the border runs “from Asher to Michmethath” in a place-list; the place-versus-tribe reading remains ambiguous. Current profile excludes it and gates secure tribe usages at17:10.

currentKeyFields.subtitleJa: エフンネの子、ケニズ人として名が記される人物
currentKeyFields.summaryJa: ユダ族の人々とともにギルガルでヨシュアのもとへ来たカレブは、カデシュ・バルネアで主がモーセを通して語ったことを引き合いに出します。本文は彼をエフンネの子、ケニズ人と呼びます。

facts.textJa: ヨシュアはカレブを祝福し、ヘブロンを相続地として与えます。
本文はヘブロンがカレブの相続地となった理由を、彼が主に忠実に従ったことと結び付けます。
ユダの相続地のうち、ヘブロン（旧名キルヤテ・アルバ）がカレブに割り当てられます。
カレブはアナクの三人の子を追い払います。
カレブはキルヤテ・セフェルを取る者に娘アクサを妻として与えると告げます。
オトニエルが町を攻略し、カレブは娘アクサを彼に与えます。
アクサが父カレブに畑を求めるよう夫に頼みます。
ヘブロンの町の畑と周囲の村は、カレブの所有として与えられます。

records.basisJa: Current subtitle/summary are compatible with 14:6: Judahites approach Joshua at Gilgal and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite speaks concerning what the LORD said at Kadesh Barnea. The former later inheritance wording is now in facts gated 14:13+.

primaryWitnesses.text: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

currentKeyFields.subtitleJa: 民数記10:29ではホバブの名で記される人物
currentKeyFields.summaryJa: 民数記10:29では、モーセがミディアン人レウエルの子ホバブに語りかけます。この節だけでは、エテロがホバブまたはレウエルと同一人物かは確定できません。
currentKeyFields.identityNoteJa: ホバブ、レウエル、エテロの名前を同一人物と断定しません。

records.basisJa: 10:29 states Hobab is son of Reuel the Midianite and calls the addressee Moses’ father-in-law, but apposition allows more than one attachment. Current record has no knownBy/passages and explicitly refuses to equate Hobab, Reuel and Jethro; this is appropriately cautious but does not resolve the candidate’s identity/link.

primaryWitnesses.text: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”
Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
“The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

currentKeyFields.subtitleJa: モーセとアロンとともに名が記される人物
currentKeyFields.summaryJa: ミリアムとアロンは、クシュ人の女性をめぐってモーセに逆らって語ります。
currentKeyFields.historicalRoleJa: モーセとアロンとともに語った人物

facts.textJa: 民数記26:59は、ミリアムをモーセとアロンの姉妹として記します。

records.basisJa: At12:1 the text names Miriam and Aaron speaking against Moses. Current always-visible fields describe only that scene; the sibling relationship is in fact26:59, gated to26:59.

primaryWitnesses.text: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
